The '''orbital service shuttle 23K''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] design produced by [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards]].

==Characteristics==
Designed to ferry personnel and supplies from a planet's surface to an orbiting [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], it was one of the most common service shuttle designs in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It required a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and could carry six passengers and one ton of cargo. The craft was 19 meters long.
